description: This file defines the DeleteFeaturePropertiesStrategy class, which handles the command to delete feature properties in a Thing entity within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It includes methods to extract features, generate deletion results, and manage entity tags related to the delete operation.

classes.name: DeleteFeaturePropertiesStrategy
classes.description: A strategy class that handles the DeleteFeatureProperties command by deleting feature properties from a Thing and generating corresponding events.

methods.name: doApply
methods.description: Executes the delete feature properties command, either successfully deleting the feature properties and returning a deletion event or returning an error if the feature is not found.

methods.name: extractFeature
methods.description: Retrieves the specified feature from the Thing, returning an Optional containing the feature if present.

methods.name: getDeleteFeaturePropertiesResult
methods.description: Creates a result for the delete operation, either as a success with an event or an error if feature properties are missing.

methods.name: previousEntityTag
methods.description: Gets the entity tag from the previous entity state related to the feature to manage concurrency.

methods.name: nextEntityTag
methods.description: Returns an empty Optional, as no specific next entity tag is produced by this command.
